Our Institution
A Legacy of Learning & Community Service
Paschim Dhemaji College was established in 1997 at Paschim Dhemaji, serving a socio-economically diverse rural community. Affiliated with Dibrugarh University and recognized by U.G.C. under 2(F) & 12(B), our institution has been a beacon of educational excellence for over two decades.
Located in an area covering 157 villages with a population exceeding 90,000, the college addresses the critical need for higher education in this region. We serve students from diverse backgrounds including ST, SC, OBC & MOBC communities.
